en: So that was it...{wait}{clear}For a human like you, Fein, I suppose an angel is something alien...{wait}{clear}
No... I do think you are different from us, but I believe we can understand each other.{wait}{clear}I'm sorry for doubting your sincerity...{wait}{clear}
Not at all. If this helps you understand us even a little, Fein, that is enough.{wait}{clear}
I see...
Did this tell you anything?{wait}{clear}
I'm sorry for offending you. But seeing your feelings show like that actually puts me at ease.{wait}{clear}
Now I know for certain that your heart is no different from ours. From here on, we should understand each other better.{wait}{clear}
Yes... If you feel that way, then I'm glad I came to see you, Fein.{wait}{clear}
Not at all. Do you need something, Fein?{wait}{clear}
No, I just thought I'd like to talk a little. Was it a bother?{wait}{clear}
Not at all.{n}
I don't have much time...{n}
No, I don't think of it as a bother. Being able to talk with you like this makes me happy too, Fein.{wait}{clear}
I see... That's good to hear. You always seem busy, ＄＄＄＄＄＄...{wait}{clear}Then, sorry, but keep me company for just a little while.{wait}{clear}
I'm sorry, I don't have much time...{wait}{clear}
I see... You really are busy, ＄＄＄＄＄＄. Then I shouldn't force you to stay.{wait}{clear}
I'm sorry...{wait}{clear}
No, it was nothing important. Let's save it for another time.{wait}{clear}
Sorry to call you out.{wait}{clear}
No, please don't worry about that. The fairy said you had something to tell me...{wait}{clear}
Yes... It's not really something to tell...{wait}{clear}The fairy said you would come if I called, ＄＄＄＄＄＄, so I wanted to try it...{wait}{clear}
So that's all it was...{n}
Do you believe me now?{n}
So that's all it was...{wait}{clear}Still, I'm glad. I thought something had happened.{wait}{clear}
You're not angry?{wait}{clear}
No, I'm not angry.{wait}{clear}Humans and angels are different kinds of beings. I'm sure you have a lot to think about...{wait}{clear}Besides, when called, going to the hero is my duty.{wait}{clear}
I'm sorry. It's true I still don't understand you very well. But testing you like this was underhanded.{wait}{clear}
No, please don't let it bother you so. I think it's good if we can understand each other little by little like this.{wait}{clear}
Thank you, ＄＄＄＄＄＄. I feel like I understand you a little better now.{wait}{clear}
Do you believe me now?{wait}{clear}
Yes. I'm sorry, ＄＄＄＄＄＄. That was rather childish of me...{wait}{clear}
No, please don't worry. It's always like this at first.{wait}{clear}
Is it? Well, it helps to hear you say that.{wait}{clear}Next time, I'll call you when I really need something.{wait}{clear}
Yes, please do.{wait}{clear}
What is it, Leyla? Is something on your mind?{wait}{clear}
It's not that...{wait}{clear}I just wanted to talk with you, ＄＄＄＄＄＄. Was it a bother, having you come for that?{wait}{clear}
No, please don't worry.{n}
Um... I'm sorry...{n}
No, please don't worry. I'm fine, so call me anytime.{wait}{clear}
Good, I'm glad...{wait}{clear}You always seem so busy, ＄＄＄＄＄＄, I felt a bit guilty...{wait}{clear}
This is my duty, after all.{wait}{clear}
I see. Then would you mind talking with me for a while?{wait}{clear}
Um... I'm sorry... I don't have much time...{wait}{clear}I can't stay long. Is that all right?{wait}{clear}
Really? You are busy after all. Then I'm the one who should apologize for keeping you.{wait}{clear}It's nothing important, so let's save it for another time.{wait}{clear}
I'm sorry, Leyla...{wait}{clear}
No, I'm the one who's sorry. See you later.{wait}{clear}
Hey, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.{wait}{clear}
Rudi, what is it? The fairy said you had something to tell me.{wait}{clear}
Well... sorry. The fairy said you'd come if I called, ＄＄＄＄＄＄, so I tested it to see if it was true.{wait}{clear}
Could you only call when you need me?{n}
Wow, you actually came. Angels sure are serious.{wait}{clear}
No... It's not about being serious... This is our duty.{wait}{clear}
I see. I feel like I understand you a little, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.{wait}{clear}Really, my bad.{wait}{clear}
Rudi... I'm sorry, but could you only call me when you need me?{wait}{clear}
Sorry, sorry. I didn't mean to make you mad.{wait}{clear}It's just, angels are different from us, right? So I got curious what you're really like...{wait}{clear}
Oh? So that was it...{wait}{clear}
But having you come like this, I feel like I figured something out.{wait}{clear}
From now on, I think we'll understand each other better.{wait}{clear}
Yes... If you feel that way, then I'm glad I came to see you, Rudi.{wait}{clear}
What is it? Is something on your mind, Rudi?{wait}{clear}
I just felt like talking with you a little, ＄＄＄＄＄＄. Was that a bother?{wait}{clear}
No, not at all.{n}
Well, a little...{n}
No, not at all.{wait}{clear}When you call me like this, we can talk about all sorts of things, and that makes me happy too.{wait}{clear}
Good to hear. You always look so busy, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.{wait}{clear}Then, sorry, but hang out with me for a bit.{wait}{clear}
Well, a little... I'm sorry, Rudi, but I don't have much time...{wait}{clear}
I see... You're busy after all.{wait}{clear}I can't make you stick around when you're that busy, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.{wait}{clear}
Nah, it's nothing that important. It's fine, let's do it another time.{wait}{clear}See ya.{wait}{clear}
Finally showed up, huh.{wait}{clear}
Rocus, has something happened? The fairy told me you had something to say.{wait}{clear}
Oh, nothing much. I was testing you.{wait}{clear}
The fairy said the Angel comes when called, so I wondered if it was true.{wait}{clear}
And?{n}
So that's why you called me? Oh, I'm relieved.{wait}{clear}I was worried something had happened, so I'm glad it was nothing serious...{wait}{clear}
Hmph. I still can't trust you. Wouldn't a normal person get angry?{wait}{clear}
Huh? But... I really am...{wait}{clear}
Honestly, what a bore... Fine, never mind. Go home.{wait}{clear}
Um...
Yeah, more or less. Plus, that angry face.{wait}{clear}
That, at least, I think I can trust a little. Someone who keeps smiling after being treated like this is harder to trust.{wait}{clear}
Is that how it works?{wait}{clear}
Yeah, for me it is.{wait}{clear}
Well, next time I'll call you when I actually have something to say.{wait}{clear}
Yes, all right. Until next time, Rocus...{wait}{clear}
What is it, Rocus? Is something on your mind?{wait}{clear}
No, nothing like that. I just thought I'd like to talk a bit... Is that all right?{wait}{clear}
Yes, of course.{n}
Not right now...{n}
Yes, of course. I'm happy you called me, Rocus.{wait}{clear}
I don't think it's anything to be that happy about... Whatever.{wait}{clear}Then keep me company for a little while.{wait}{clear}
Not right now... I'm sorry, Rocus, but I don't have much time...{wait}{clear}
No time to spare for me? How nice to be so busy, Angel.{wait}{clear}
Um... it's not like that... But I'm sorry...{wait}{clear}
Well, whatever. It wasn't anything important. I'll call you again sometime. Sometime.{wait}{clear}
Yes, all right. I'm truly sorry.{wait}{clear}
No, please don't worry about that. By the way, has something happened?{wait}{clear}
No, it's nothing that serious... I just wanted to talk with you a little, Angel...{wait}{clear}I'm sorry for being selfish...{wait}{clear}
You called me, Cecia...{n}
So that was it.{n}
You called me, Cecia, so I came.{wait}{clear}And I... wanted to see you too...{wait}{clear}
Oh? Really? I'm so happy...{wait}{clear}Thank you, Angel...{wait}{clear}
Well then, since we're here, shall we talk?{wait}{clear}
So that was it... But please don't think of it as selfish.{wait}{clear}
I wanted to talk with you too, after all...{wait}{clear}
Angel... really...?{wait}{clear}
Thank goodness... I was afraid I was getting in your way, Angel.{wait}{clear}
When I'm busy, I'll tell you so.{wait}{clear}
Then you'll keep me company for a talk?{wait}{clear}
What is it, Cecia? Is there something you want to talk about?{wait}{clear}
Yes... I'm sorry to bother you at such a difficult time, but there's something I'd like to talk about...{wait}{clear}That's why I called you, Angel. Do you have time?{wait}{clear}
Is something troubling you?{n}
Yes, of course I do!{n}
Is something troubling you?{wait}{clear}
No, it's not like that. Did I only make you worry again...?{wait}{clear}
